insights.one_liner: Sia Partners is a Paris-founded management consulting firm focused on AI, with an Amsterdam office and IND sponsor status.

culture.text: It has about 3,000 professionals in 48 offices across 19 countries, and leans heavily into AI consulting and AI agents.
It runs annual seminars and has a dedicated recruitment track for new graduates and interns.
Its 2 open jobs here are senior data and AI roles in Amsterdam.

open.text: Sia Partners is an IND recognised sponsor.
Both current postings mention visa or relocation; one of the two needs no Dutch.

growth.text: Staff grew from 600 in 2015 to 3,000 in 2025.
It bought Seven Consulting to expand in Australia.
OpenAI promoted Sia to Advanced Partner in its partner network.
